summary: Routeway models with ':free' appended to their ID (for example deepseek-r1:free) cost $0.00. They are capped at 200 requests per day, which resets at 00:00 UTC, and requests over the limit return 429. The docs FAQ gives a 20 requests/minute cap while the rate-limits page gives 5 RPM. The caps cannot be raised. Free models are intended for development, testing, and experimentation only, with no uptime or latency guarantees. Dropping the ':free' suffix switches to the paid pay-as-you-go model.
claim_steps: Sign up or log in at routeway.ai/dashboard
Click Create API Key, give it a name, and confirm
Copy and store the key securely — it won't be shown again
Call a model ID with the :free suffix (e.g. deepseek-r1:free)

social_proof.title: Frequently Asked Questions
social_proof.text: They cost $0.00 but are rate-limited to 20 requests/minute and 200 requests/day. The daily limit (200 RPD) resets at 00:00 UTC each day. There are no uptime or latency guarantees on free models.

social_proof.title: Rate Limits
social_proof.text: Free models (e.g., deepseek-r1:free) are subject to the following rate limits: 5 Requests Per Minute (RPM), 200 Requests Per Day (RPD). Once exceeded, requests to free models will return a 429 status code.
